conservative.read: This conservative plan targets capital preservation with a potential ~1.5%/month return. It significantly de-risks the portfolio by cutting leveraged ETFs and reducing concentration. Expect lower drawdowns but also more modest growth potential.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for risk-first growth, targeting ~2.5%/month. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while blending broad index exposure with quality tech and a small hedge. Expect moderate drawdowns and growth.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets stretch growth, aiming for ~4%/month. It leans into leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this significantly raises both upside and drawdown potential, and leveraged ETFs decay daily. Strict stop discipline is crucial to manage the higher risk.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Sell CRWD and SMH to zero to cut high-beta single names.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and cure the mandate breach.
Add to QQQI, targeting 30% of the book, to rotate into income ETFs.

income.read: This income plan prioritizes parking cash for yield, targeting ~1%/month. It rotates heavily into income ETFs and broad index exposure, cutting all leveraged and high-beta single names. While aiming for steady distributions and low drawdown, distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff.
